page.notes: Greek marginal note beside "Casus" is only partly legible; its uncertain letters are marked as illegible or with [?]. The Greek word after "promissionibus" (ἐπακτοῖς) is read with some doubt. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout, so "Casus" and "est" appear as s-forms. The reference mark "b" in the text is written as {b} before "Nec". The word "ab" at the foot is treated as a catchword. The last line of the note text has a faint stop beside it, which is not transcribed.
